title: What Visual Programming 2.0 Is
definition: Visual Programming 2.0: visual languages with real software power.
description:
Visual Programming 2.0: visual languages with real software power. This is Future Software Paradigms at its most ambitious — node canvases research, language logistics engineering and abstraction tools operations converging on a single goal: making language hulls real.

Why it matters: Future Software Paradigms will decide text interop outcomes this century. Visual Programming 2.0 is one of the load-bearing ideas: without working language hulls, the larger node canvases vision stalls, and with it, the language logistics systems that depend on it.

This database documents Visual Programming 2.0 in full: what it is, the real research behind it today, the pieces it is built from, dated forecasts, runnable demo programs, and a teaching ladder from foundations to mastery. Every record carries a working program you can run.

title: Real Research Today: Visual Programming 2.0
definition: Today's documented research behind Visual Programming 2.0.
description:
The road to Visual Programming 2.0 is already being paved. WebAssembly brings sandboxed near-native code to every browser and edge device. Formal methods adoption grows in aerospace (NASA), chips (Intel/ARM) and crypto protocols.

Projectional editing (JetBrains MPS) lets languages reshape the editor itself. Together these programs form the node canvases foundation that Visual Programming 2.0 will build on — the language logistics results, the abstraction tools methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as language logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

title: Readiness Estimator: Visual Programming 2.0
definition: Estimates Visual Programming 2.0 readiness from component maturity.

The estimator scores the six Visual Programming 2.0 components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a language hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Visual Programming 2.0 Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Visual Programming 2.0: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Visual Programming 2.0 — visual languages with real software power.

Phase 1 — Prove (node canvases): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (language logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (abstraction tools): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (text interop): language hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and education-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
